scenes.title: Two Baskets and a List
scenes.summary: After Kenji restores kitchen power, Mio and Yuka grab woven baskets to shop at the Saturday neighbourhood market while Kenji rewires Room 9.

scenes.title: Sweet Lemons and Golden Honey
scenes.summary: At the bustling Saturday market, Yuka teaches Mio how to choose fragrant lemons and honey when Daiki spots them and helps carry the heavy jars.

scenes.title: Twelve White Cups
scenes.summary: Haruto meets the group at the market pottery stall and helps Mio and Yuka choose thick white stoneware cups that keep tea hot.

scenes.title: Thursday Means Today?
scenes.summary: Back at the inn, Takashi proudly tells Kenji about the bargain café chairs he ordered—then realises he said 'Saturday' instead of 'Thursday'.

scenes.title: A Mountain of Chairs
scenes.summary: Mio and Yuka return from the market to find Takashi trapped behind towers of unpainted folding chairs blocking the courtyard path.

scenes.title: Light in Room Nine
scenes.summary: Using the black tape from the market, Kenji finishes the new copper wiring and switches on the warm glass ceiling lamp in Room 9.

scenes.title: Inside the Piano Lid
scenes.summary: Under the new ceiling lamp, Kazuko, Mio, and Haruto pull a folded sheet of handwritten piano music from behind the wooden music rest.

scenes.title: Ask My Aunt's Ledger
scenes.summary: Kazuko shows Takashi the unfinished handwritten waltz, and Takashi recognises his late aunt's handwriting—right as the city clerk leaves an urgent message.
